records.short_anchor: The density model was used to estimate the
records.audit_interpretation: Radio drift is converted to front height and pattern speed through a density model. It is not a pre-front plasma velocity.

records.short_anchor: there is no other solar eruption at the same time
records.audit_interpretation: Timing supports the same eruption and the published common-shock interpretation, without a radio sky position for PA116.

records.short_anchor: The Newkirk coronal electron density model
records.audit_interpretation: The radio/EUV height comparison depends on a density-to-height model and does not supply an independent radio image.

records.short_anchor: Results for regions 1 and 4 were not statistically
records.audit_interpretation: The upstream comparison region R4 has no statistically significant DEM result here; a DEM is not a normal-flow measurement.

records.short_anchor: solar wind speed is negligible compared to the shock
records.audit_interpretation: Negligible solar-wind speed is a premise used to derive Alfven speed and B. No same-patch velocity estimate or uncertainty accompanies it.

records.short_anchor: We have no imaging observation at radio wavelengths
records.audit_interpretation: The authors explicitly state the missing radio imaging. Nose emission is assumed; the approximate 4% height argument does not localize the source to the RMO patch.

records.short_anchor: temperature, density, and line of sight depth (dl)
records.audit_interpretation: The E11 result fits post-passage emission histories under ionization and background assumptions; it does not measure the upstream velocity vector.

scope_limit: Conclusions concern the retained E11 material. They do not establish that no additional observation exists in any archive.
source_credit: Published observations and model results remain credited to their original authors. R136 adds an independence and local-association audit.
